reason: The XSS vulnerability claim is invalid because the user-controlled input is sanitized via org.apache.commons.lang.StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml(param) before being passed to the HTML encoder. The value is further encoded with ESAPI.encodeForHTML(), which safely escapes special characters for display in HTML.
